0022600129.text: The Knicks (0-2, 11th in the East) host the Pistons (2-0, 1st in the East and 1st in the Central) as New York looks to snap a two-game losing streak against a Detroit side riding a two-game winning streak. New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), while Detroit is without Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27; their last meeting came on February 19, 2026, in New York, when the Knicks lost 126-111, and the Knicks lost the 2025-26 season series 0-3.
